sources.title: Releases · OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V-Apps · GitHub
sources.snippet: The user-facing model name is now MiniCPM5-1B (Q4_K_M)(was MiniCPM5 0.9B), matching the public release. Existing v2.0 users with a MiniCPM5-0.9B-Q4_K_M.ggufon disk will see it auto-renamed to MiniCPM5-1B-Q4_K_M.gguf; the downstream integrity check then either accepts the bytes or quietly re-downloads the canonical file (~656 MB).
